facts.text: Kingo, put the camera away. We are having dinner, and it's been seven thousand years.
facts.why: Sersi never says this. The quote page lists her real line about the Eternals arriving seven thousand years ago, which keeps the same theme.
facts.fix: We're Eternals. We came here seven thousand years ago, to protect humans from the Deviants.
